verdict.tagline: Big ambitions bogged down by crashes and technical hurdles.
for_you_if: you have infinite patience for tactical multiplayer
you can wait out long mod downloads
you enjoy large scale military simulation
not_for_you_if: you will not install kernel level anti cheat
you need stable performance without crashes
you are unwilling to navigate server queues

claims.claim: Reviewers experience GPU hanging errors that prevent them from playing the game.

citations.review_text: Spent four hours downloading. GPU hanging errors- reinstall arma, gpu drivers, even uninstall windows (not that bad cause new pc)- no fix. Google the error and find a text thread dating back 2 years ago about same issues. I lost about 8 hours to this game w out a single minute played, gonna play squad instead.

Maybe there is a good game somewhere here, but I wasn't able to find it because the game crashes with the GPU HANG error within a couple of minutes of trying to play the tutorial. Seems to be a problem no matter what company your GPU\CPU are from and devs haven't addressed or even really spoke about it for 1.5 years despite me finding a ton of people not being able to play.

Also, despite this being the updated version of the ARMA engine, in the couple of minutes that I've managed to play the game for it ran at 80FPS in the tutorial, yikes.

claims.claim: Reviewers report severe stuttering and frame drops related to asset streaming and chunk loading during movement.

citations.review_text:
I would love to play this, but my issues come down to one simple thing:

I get horrible stuttering every time a new "chunk" loads - doesn't matter if I'm driving, flying, or on foot. Every X amount of in game distance and clearly assets are loading causing a stutter spike until it's fully loaded. I've followed every bit of literature I can find about improving performance, both official and not and I cannot get it work right. Neither can anyone else in my household and it's an issue that crops up on streamers I've seen as well. I've tried this a few times and had to refund each time. Until this is fixed I'm sticking with Arma 3 + mods and being annoyed.

I'm brand new to mil-sims, and only have a few hours in this game, but I'm already hooked. I genuinely have no idea what is going on still, and there is still a lot to learn, but the immersion and core gameplay alone make this game worth playing.
My first match started off with me wandering around aimlessly for 15 minutes before finding a group of people coordinating an attack. I told them I was new and asked if I could tag along, and within five minutes of joining them I got my first kill. We split up into 2 groups and kept pushing, and eventually took over the objective, and were quickly ambushed by enemies. Everyone I was with died, except for myself and one other person, and somehow we managed to escape. As soon as I thought I was in the clear, I got my ♥♥♥♥ blown smooth off by some guy standing on the side of the road. Then I just died a whole lot until my game inevitably crashed.

Despite spending so much time walking around and dying, the fact that my first engagement with other people was so exciting and satisfying leaves me itching to come back. The game has serious performance issues on my hardware despite meeting the minimum specs, but this game is so unique and immersive that I'm willing to overlook the ♥♥♥♥♥♥ frametimes and constant FPS drops. The community seems very welcoming to beginners and that alone is a huge positive compared to other games in the genre.

This game is what I wanted Battlefield 6 to be.

Developers are literal clowns who had 3 years to fix those types of bugs, yet they chose to produce a single DLC (still in 3  years times mind you) rather than actually working on a playable basic version of their ♥♥♥♥.

citations.review_text: Its a good game but sry if it maxes out my 1300$ RTX 5080 Gaming trio (wich not even star citizen or cyberpunk would do) then i cant leave a good review about it. i dont know exactly what it is but i feel like this game is totally hard coded... like "just make it work and dont care about the rest". Pretty sloppy for a company that is in the bussines for what ... 10 years=?

Definitely not what i was expecting. After spending 68 minutes just to complete a handful of tutorial missions and dying twice, I decided to hop in a quick Conflict game. The official server was dead empty. 

Game is very badly optimized. I had to play on "normal" graphics just to hit a constant 80-90FPS, with a 13 Series i7 and a RTX 5070Ti. Also, IIRC there´s no DLSS support. It lags and glitches periodically even in the Tutorial.

The tutorial itself is very poorly explained, so you have to figure out what button to press, where to look or what to do, because the game simply does not explain how to. 

Since Steam forces us to play only 2h before refunding, I couldn't get pass the Tutorial.

If youre not a Arma veteran, this game is definitely not for you.

citations.review_text: doesnt have a way to setup basic pedals, rudder pedals, joystick controls. i am an hour in and thinking of getting a refund, getting my peripherals to work in a sim game should not be hard. where is the native support. unless i go through dozens of youtube tutorials and look at a wall of config files to figure out a way to custom emulate the setup. thats a whole day of my life. i would rather get  a refund and not look back.

Don't Bother Buying Arma Reforger In It's Current State!

Arma Reforger is dissapoment for me - and I lost hope for Arma 4 to be somehow better then the rest.
I got this game gifted by a friend for my birth day, had it a while in my whistlist, over 1,000h on Arma III.

All the cinematics on this page, footage, etc. looks nice and all, but when i launched the game i already run in to issues: 

1. Nickname
First of all if you have a longer steam name or special characters (maybe becuase you just like estethics) you're done for, you'll need to edit your name, otherwise it will be cut, fascinating that games like Foxhole or other games on Steam (and outside) have no issue with longer names or speical characters at times.

Some games simply hide the speical characters in your nickname, but what is more annoying is the stupidly short character limit for name, or not being able (having the option) to set custom one.

There is an option to log in to your Bohemia Interactive (BI) account, i thought "Great, i'd have to change my steam name as it's cut, but i can use my BI name which should fit well!". Nope, all what logging in to your BI account does it.. You are logged in to your BI account.

2. Closing the game
If you alt tab and just lick on the "X" to close the game, the game will have a stroke, freeze, lag/slow down your computer, and after about a minute shut down.

Obviosuly other games may do the same if closed this way as well, and i can confirm that closing it by the in-game "exit" works smoothly, the difference is while closing other games they don't cause nowhere near as much issues as when closing Arma Reforget this way.

3. Performance (Specs attached below)
Before launching the tutorial i went to settings to turn down the volume of the music, as every audio settings is set to 100%. while there i noticed that my graphics is set to "medium", i thought that this is basic graphic settings so i set it to Ultra as i got brand new gaming notbeook with high(er) tier sp…

I tried for a refund but it was recused because of the time "played" (basicly I tried 4 servers, so 3/4 hours to set up and download each server's content for mostly 20/30 minutes per server)

claims.claim: Vehicle physics cause cars and humvees to explode or flip violently after hitting minor terrain bumps or ditches.

citations.review_text:
I installed this game thinking I was getting a military simulator.

Instead, I got PTSD from trees.

One minute I'm leading a perfectly coordinated assault. The next, my driver somehow flips a Humvee into low Earth orbit after hitting what I can only assume was an aggressive pebble.

Communication goes from:
"Enemy north, 300 meters!"

to

"WHO THE HELL STOLE THE HELICOPTER?"

Five minutes later the helicopter is upside down in a lake, the pilot says it was "part of the plan," and somehow we still win the objective.

You'll spend 45 minutes planning an attack that lasts 12 seconds because Dave forgot what blue smoke meant and called artillery on the squad.

The enemy isn't the other team.

It's your own teammates.

You'll die to:

A bush.
A teammate backing over you.
Someone yelling "clear backblast" half a second too late.
Falling down a hill because your soldier has the balance of a drunk giraffe.

Every firefight feels like you're starring in an action movie directed by absolute idiots, and somehow that's exactly what makes this game amazing.

10/10.

Would absolutely spend two hours driving logistics just to get vaporized by one guy hiding in a tree again.

Myself and my buddies have been playing this game ever since it was released. Both on console and PC. 

Over the years, this game has gone downhill with these updates. The changes to driving mechanics, physics, voting systems, and combat have decreased in overall quality. 

I'm not saying the game needs to go back into the way the development phase was, but these developers have no common sense or care for how the game has turned out. 

God forbid there's a small group a friends playing together, out of 24 players, and they decided to start a vote to kick you just because its funny. Then your banned from playing the game for 5-30 minutes. 

God forbid you shoot somebody full auto and point blank and they turn around and shoot you once and you immediately die. 

God forbid the developers favorite American over soviet teams. 

God forbid you drive a car in the game and the car explodes over hitting a minor ditch in the road or grass. 

Overall, the developers have changed the mechanics, UI, and gameplay to the point where it's unplayable. They came out with a great game, and after the updates the game is unrecognizable from when it first came out. 

Stop changing things to the point where the game is unplayable. You can have fun with the game. But it's difficult to at this point because you're lucky if you can even play the game for 30 minutes without being ♥♥♥♥♥♥ over or dying by the most ridiculous physics in a game I've ever seen. 

I'd rather play femboy futa house than spend time on this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥.

It's the same story as always, let's rush to put out a game in an early development stage. A stage where the game was perfectly fine the way it was. Then let's put a ridiculous amount of updates on the game and force full development to the point where the game is unrecognizable and completely terrible from what it was originally put out as.

citations.review_text: harsh game at the start but become very immersive once you get your bearings. 8.5/10 game hit reg needs a tweek and game disconnextions do as it isnt very optimised also but other than that its great

Needs a lot of work in terms of hit registration, desync and quality of life features.

As one of the dedicated truckers(because I hate to see my entire team starving of supplies), we need all the QoL features that we can get starting from the experience of driving, picking up supplies and delivering them to bases(also need to be rewarded much better, it's a thankless job that NEEDS to be done in order to win the damn game).

Heli CAS is too strong in vanilla at the moment and both teams require some AAA like ZU-23-2.

Also need to mention the modded experience is not stable, your game might frequently crash or you might get kicked from the server.(the silver lining is that the game will put you back into a priority queue and if your character didn't die, you will spawn at the exact location with the exact gear that you had when you got kicked)

I would let them cook for another year before I buy. Maybe even wait for Arma 4...

I will update this if I see significant improvements in these areas.

The game has been out for years yet does not offer official servers with 100 players, instead the only servers available are 48 player servers, with 3 factions that can often mean you have only 13 enemies or less on a giant map. If you want to actually encounter enemies and gameplay like the trailers and on youtube you'll need to play community servers and be subjected to 300 ping or play highly modded slop garbage and toxic communities, in all of australia there are 0 vanilla 128 player servers and the hitreg for having 200+ ping means 50% of your shots, sometimes 90%, do not register, making the game effectively unplayable in Australia if you just want a normal vanilla experience.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game suffers from crashes and stability issues during multiplayer sessions.

citations.review_text: I have a love hate relationship with ARMA the game itself is fantastic. It scratches about every itch I have for the milsim genre. The visuals and sounds make it feel alive. This is my first Bohemia game and my biggest problem is the server stability. It is damn near unplayable. I will not be coming back until the issues are fixed. I will not purchase ARMA 4 unless I can play a full match without being booted or the server being reset. There are plenty of other games such as Squad, Hell Let Loose, Gray Zone Warfare or Operator to hold me over. It is truly disappointing because out of all the titles listed ARMA is still my favorite when it comes to gameplay. When and IF they ever fix the server stability issues I have no problem recommending the game but until that happens I cannot.

Crashes a lot

Multiplayer is often super disorganized (in a game that needs it). You are killed out of nowhere 95% of the time by some guy camping, or by your own team being clueless idiots, or by someone on your own team intentionally for "touching their truck" and then they say you teamkilled them and then they start a successful votekick on you. 

It often feels like other players are cheating. Opposing players seem to very often always know where you are, even if you try to be sneaky. It could just be how the game works or actual skill, but idk getting sniped in one shot by a BTR from miles away when you are prone behind a tree in a forest in camo feels cheap either way.

The community is like 1/3 cool people looking for (but not always providing) tactical gameplay, and 2/3s the cliched army wannabes/stolen valor losers and toxic gamers.

It's not as much fun as seen online.

claims.claim: Reviewers state that modded servers suffer from instability and require downloading large amounts of mods.

citations.review_text: The modded servers (which almost everyone plays rather than vanilla), are unstable a lot of the time. Still worth it though, even on console I had more fun on this game than I could've ever expected. It's definitly worth it if you have the patience

★★★★★

10/10, absolute masterpiece of organised chaos. One minute you’re calmly defending a checkpoint, the next you’ve got the entire squad screaming callouts, someone yelling “ALLAHU AKBAR!” in proximity chat, and a Russian teammate screaming something completely incomprehensible while a helicopter explodes in the background.

The only downside? Every time you join a new server, you apparently need to download 47 gigabytes of mods you’ve never heard of, wait 25 minutes, and then discover the server has changed maps.

But once you finally load in? Pure cinema. Terrible tactics, questionable teamwork, random explosions, and somehow we still capture the objective.

Would absolutely download another 300 mods just to do it all again.

citations.review_text: update broke my game, constant crashing, freezing and low fps

The game is not playable after 1.7 update. Crashes every 5-10 minutes. Excuse me for being maybe too blunt, but I don't know if the developers have even tested the new update properly before releasing. Or did you vibecode this update? And no, mods are not the issue - vanilla servers are crashing too, although not as often as the modded ones. Nevertheless, even if the issue was caused solely by mods which worked well on the previous version, it would still be insane for the developers to release this crappy update, since most come here for modded experience - devs essentially let down most of the Reforger's community by releasing it. It adds very little and breaks literally everything - the entire game. The red notifications saying "player disconnected: connection timeout" which means somebody's game crashed pop up every 5-10 seconds!! People have to rejoin the server many times just to create and save their loadout - it's impossible to do without crashing! I keep seeing people editing their loadout at the arsenal, and then disappearing, every 5-10 seconds!! Why couldn't you release a beta version, keeping the old working one and leave it up to the servers to decide which version they want to be on? Everything worked, everybody enjoyed the game. Now the online keeps dropping every day - you can look at the online chart yourself if you don't believe me. I'll go back to Arma 3... Huge thanks, Bohemia, truly a great update.

I really wanted to enjoy the modding in Arma Reforger, but it's been more frustrating than fun.

The game has some incredibly talented mod creators, but the overall modding experience is a mess. Every update seems to break something, servers constantly have mod version mismatches, and downloading dozens of mods just to join a server can take ages. Even after everything finally installs, there's still a chance you'll get kicked, crash, or run into dependency errors.

Performance also suffers on many heavily modded servers, making the experience inconsistent. Instead of spending time playing, I often find myself troubleshooting mods or waiting for downloads.

The potential is definitely there, and the community deserves credit for the amazing content they've created. Unfortunately, the system supporting that content still feels unreliable and frustrating.

**Pros:**

* Talented modding community.
* Huge variety of content.

**Cons:**

* Updates frequently break mods.
* Long download times.
* Mod compatibility issues.
* Performance problems on many servers.
* Too much time spent troubleshooting instead of playing.
* Lack of support from game devs.

Until the modding experience becomes more stable and reliable, I can't recommend it.

This game is little more than a console game with a terrible PC port.

None of the tools that Arma 3 benefits from exist here. Steam Workshop was promised but then later denied because it would take "too much effort." How many small, one-man indie games do you know that have managed this "herculean" task? Their own implementation of a "Workshop" still, after 3 years, downloads to your C: drive at an astonishingly slow speed.

The entire user interface is built for console. It's as if you're using the Windows 8 Start menu without being able to go to the desktop with endless tiles that feel like some 2012 touchscreen garbage. The Xbox One dashboard was more keyboard and mouse friendly.

One of the "major" updates was just mod support for PS5 and nothing else. Good for PS5, but is it really worth the version jump to 1.4? Usually, we wait half a year for them to add one gun and a tweak to AI driving, so this was extra disappointing.

The most recent update added the FIA as a third playable faction to an official gamemode. (The FIA were already in the game, just not in this one gamemode). It took them 8 months to adjust one gamemode, with no other new content apart from movement changes. This same update also broke just about every community mod.

Also, they have an outright scam on their website for the Collector's Edition of the game. For €300 (about $350), you get three copies of the game, a box, a $45 off-the-shelf KDW model of a Humvee that doesn't even match the version in-game, a plastic canteen, and some maps, postcards, and patches. That is about $150 worth of swag. They also deleted bad reviews of the product on their website and then added the two extra copies of the game after the fact (it was previously just one copy). To top it all off, you still have to pay for shipping.

This game might be awesome if you're on console, but if you’re on PC reading this review, just buy Arma 3 instead. It's a game made for PC players. Hopefully, Arma 4 won't treat PC player…

claims.claim: Players report that official servers lack proper moderation, allowing team killers and trolls to ruin matches without consequences.

citations.review_text:
The gameplay itself is solid. The gunplay, movement, and Conflict mode all work well, and when you get a squad that actually cooperates it's one of the best milsim experiences out there.

The problem is the official servers. There's basically no moderation. Team killers run around shooting their own side with no consequences, and people will burn through vehicles and supplies or wreck a base just to see what happens. Nothing gets done about it. You can lose an hour of progress because one guy decided to be a problem, and he'll still be there next round. It's shocking to run across a known troll that I've seen 6+ months off and on still doing this on OFFICIAL SERVERS.

it has a lot of potential but as is it needs a major rework as it is full of bugs and trolls with no moderators on official servers and modded servers require downloads bigger than the base game itself and have server queues that can take hours at times and on top of that this game is so horribly optimized that even with the best gpu you will have to dial back your graphics to maintain a decent framerate and on top of that the mechanics for moving and shooting are like they tried to mimic a broken robot they don't appear nor feel natural so overall its basically just a stepping stone towards a finished game that probably wont ever happen and they decided to sell it. That being said it can be a good game at times but it is never consistently good and at usually feels like a beta test
